import numpy as np
from typing import List

def minimumDistance(points):
    points = sorted(points, key=lambda xy: xy[0])
    p = [xy[0] + xy[1] for xy in points]
    m = [xy[0] - xy[1] for xy in points]
    pmin = p.index(min(p))
    pmax = p.index(max(p))
    mmin = m.index(min(m))
    mmax = m.index(max(m))
    if p[pmax] - p[pmin] >= m[mmax] - m[mmin]:
        i = pmax
        j = pmin
    else:
        i = mmin
        j = mmax
    return max(p[pmax] - p[pmin], m[mmax] - m[mmin]), i, j
